headline: Middle East Tensions Surge as U.S. Expands Strike Capabilities via UK Bases
subheadline: British military facilities now host U.S. B-1 Lancer bombers targeting Iranian infrastructure amid regional escalation.
lede: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon targeted Hezbollah infrastructure, including a 150-meter breach in the security zone, while Houthi forces banned Saudi maritime navigation. UK PM Burnham approved British bases for U.S. strikes against Iran, continuing prior policy. Iranian drones intercepted by Jordanian air defenses, with five reported downed.

sections.title: Russian Advances in Kharkov Region
sections.body: Russian forces reportedly liberated Volokhovskoye in Kharkov region. Drone attack on a civilian bus in Belgorod killed five, including a child. Wildberries warehouse attacks in Elektrostal and Kotovske caused fires. Russian strikes on ports and energy infrastructure reported.

sections.title: Hezbollah and Houthi Escalation
sections.body: Israeli airstrikes in southern Lebanon targeted Hezbollah infrastructure, including a 150-meter breach in the security zone. Houthi forces banned Saudi maritime navigation, warning of a 'comprehensive and harsh' response. UK PM Burnham approved British bases for U.S. strikes against Iran.

sections.title: Regional Conflict Dynamics
sections.body: Iran's Houthi proxies have escalated threats against Saudi maritime navigation, signaling a potential for broader regional conflict. U.S. and Israeli operations targeting Iranian military infrastructure risk further retaliation. The involvement of British bases in U.S. strikes against Iran introduces new geopolitical dynamics.
